scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p server && vite build && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=server-dist/main.mjs --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
scripts.test:online: npm run build:server && esbuild test/netclient.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=server-dist/netclient.test.mjs --log-level=warning && node server-dist/netclient.test.mjs
